7001.name: Alchemical Bomb
7001.desc: Drag it onto an empty battlefield cell to place it. When an enemy steps on it, it deals 18 damage; the tool is then used up.

7002.name: Frost Trap
7002.desc: Drag it onto an empty battlefield cell to place it. When an enemy steps on it, it deals 2 damage and inflicts Frozen for 1 turn; the tool is then used up.

7003.name: Poison Flask
7003.desc: Drag it onto an empty battlefield cell to place it. When an enemy steps on it, it deals 8 damage and inflicts Poisoned; afterwards that enemy takes 8 more damage at the end of each enemy turn, for 3 resolutions in total (same rule as Poison Mire); the tool is then used up.

7004.name: Piercing Trap
7004.desc: Drag it onto an empty battlefield cell to place it. When an enemy steps on it, it deals 10 damage and inflicts Rooted for 1 turn; the tool is then used up.

7005.name: Minor Health Flask
7005.desc: Tap it twice to use it, no dragging needed. Instantly restores 20% Health (up to max Health); the tool is then used up.

7006.name: Mana Potion
7006.desc: Tap it twice to use it, no dragging needed. Instantly restores 2 Cost; the tool is then used up.

7007.name: Barbecue
7007.desc: Tap it twice to use it, no dragging needed. Instantly restores 25% of your Max Health (rounded up, capped at your Max Health); the tool is then used up. It can only be cooked at a Rest Stop.

7008.name: Wild Totem
7008.desc: Tap it twice to use it, no dragging needed. All your allies gain +2 Power for the rest of this battle; the tool is then used up.

7009.name: Wildcard
7009.desc: Tap it twice to use it, no dragging needed. Choose a card from your draw pile; an ephemeral copy of it joins your hand with its cost reduced to 0 (the copy vanishes at the end of the turn). The tool is then used up.

7010.name: Express Duck
7010.desc: Tap it twice to use it, no dragging needed. Fills your tool bar with random shop tools. The tool is then used up.

7011.name: Mystery Card
7011.desc: Tap it twice to use it, no dragging needed. Choose one of 3 random cards to join your hand; its cost is 0 for this turn. The tool is then used up.

7012.name: Stone
7012.desc: Drag it onto an enemy unit. Deals 15 damage to it, then the tool is used up.

7013.name: Card Pack
7013.desc: Tap it twice to use it, no dragging needed. Fills your hand with random cards; the tool is then used up.

7014.name: Potion of Wisdom
7014.desc: Tap it twice to use it, no dragging needed. Draws 3 cards; the tool is then used up.

7015.name: Pufferfish
7015.desc: Drag it onto an empty battlefield cell. An enemy that steps on it is knocked back one cell and takes 3 damage; the tool is then used up.

7016.name: Explosive Mushroom
7016.desc: Drag it onto an empty battlefield cell. An enemy that steps on it sets it off, dealing 15 damage to every unit within one cell, friend or foe; the tool is then used up.

7017.name: Garlic
7017.desc: Drag it onto an empty battlefield cell to place it. That cell cannot be used for 3 of your turns — no unit can enter or pass through it; the tool is then used up.
